results: 1. Full neurological examination, including mental status, cranial nerves, visual fields, eye movements, strength, tone, reflexes, sensation, coordination, gait, and Romberg testing
cranial nerve examination: dysarthria, dysphagia, broken pursuit eye movements and orofacial dyskinesia
muscle tone examination: normal limb and neck tone with leftward truncal dystonic flexion and antecollis
deep tendon reflexes and plantar responses: normal reflexes and flexor plantar responses
coordination examination (limb and truncal): chorea and orofacial dyskinesia; limb coordination normal
vertical saccades and gaze range (up and down): full
smooth pursuit and saccade velocity: broken pursuit eye movements
gait observation including turning and doorways: not recorded

serum calcium, magnesium and phosphate: normal

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Huntington disease due to a pathogenic CAG trinucleotide-repeat expansion in the HTT gene

Alternative: Wilson disease due to ATP7B-related copper accumulation

Alternative: Neuroacanthocytosis, particularly VPS13A disease

Alternative: Drug-induced chorea/dystonia, especially tardive dyskinesia
